newsitem.title: UK: UK's Brown ousts BoE from EMU guideline plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Brown ousts BoE from EMU guideline plan - paper.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer (finance minister), Gordon Brown, has wrested production of EMU guidelines for UK firms from the Bank of England, the Times said on Tuesday.
The Treasury was now working on detailed guidelines which would advise businesses how to prepare for European economic and monetary union, the newspaper said.
The Times said the guidelines, which would be published within months, would spell out precisely what the euro will mean for British companies.
EMU, including the introduction of the European Union's planned single currency, the euro, is prescribed by EU law to take place no later than January 1, 1999.
